title: No line-up: Consumer Staples rising while the indexes are not
tag: Line-up: none of my three lights today (lining up: my three signals agree).
lead: Line-up: none of my three lights today (lining up: my three signals agree)

Hot sector (strongest vs SPY): Consumer Staples, rising while the tide goes out, a crosscurrent (a sector moving against the tide)

convergence.summary: Today none of the three point the same way. My rules look for all three together.
items: Not lined up: the tide. DIA closed above rising trend lines, SPY, QQQ and IWM did not.

Not lined up: the strongest names. WMT, KDP and KMB are rising and stronger than SPY inside Consumer Staples, though the sector itself is not lined up.
